edges.reason: msg.sender is used by the constructor to receive the whole initial supply, giving the caller privileged minting power.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _initialAmount into the balances mapping.
Constructor assigns totalSupply = _initialAmount.
Constructor assigns the token name state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Interface declaration transfer is implemented by CharityCommonweal.transfer.
Interface declaration transferFrom is implemented by CharityCommonweal.transferFrom.
Interface declaration balanceOf is implemented by CharityCommonweal.balanceOf.
Interface declaration approve is implemented by CharityCommonweal.approve.
Interface declaration allowance is implemented by CharityCommonweal.allowance.
msg.sender is used in transfer to index and mutate the caller-controlled balances entry.
transfer executes the unchecked subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _value.
msg.sender supplies the mapping key whose balance is decremented.
_value is the amount subtracted from the sender balance.
transfer executes the unchecked addition balances[_to] += _value.
_to supplies the mapping key of the credited balance.
_value is the amount added to the receiver balance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked addition balances[_to] += _value.
_to supplies the mapping key of the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value is the amount added to the receiver balance in transferFrom.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction balances[_from] -= _value.
_from supplies the mapping key of the debited balance in transferFrom.
_value is the amount subtracted from the source balance in transferFrom.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction of the allowance, allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
_from is the first key of the allowance mapping that is decremented.
msg.sender is the spender key whose allowance is decremented.
_value is the amount subtracted from the stored allowance.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] is read into the local allowance variable.
The cached local allowance is compared against MAX_UINT256 and drives the allowance decrement.
MAX_UINT256 is compared with the local allowance to decide whether to skip the allowance decrement.
balances[_from] is checked by require before the transferFrom debit, gating the operation.
The allowed mapping is read by transferFrom to authorize spending on behalf of _from.
balances[msg.sender] is checked by require before the transfer debit.

normalization_plan.reason: _initialAmount is only consumed by the constructor minting logic.
_tokenName is only assigned to the name state variable by the constructor.
_decimalUnits is only assigned to the decimals state variable by the constructor.
_tokenSymbol is only assigned to the symbol state variable by the constructor.
_to is only used as the credited mapping key inside transfer.
_value is only used in the two balance mutations of transfer.
_from is only used in the source balance debit and allowance logic of transferFrom.
_to is only used as the credited mapping key inside transferFrom.
_value is only used in the arithmetic mutations of transferFrom.
_owner is only used as the lookup key in balanceOf.
_spender is only used as the allowance key in approve.
_value is only written into the allowance mapping by approve.
_owner is only used as the lookup key in allowance.
_spender is only used as the lookup key in allowance.
The local allowance copy exists only to support the require check and allowance decrement inside transferFrom.
